reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "General range you'll see is up to about 400mg a day for most healthy adults, often 200ish taken an hour or so before the gun. But pills make dosing easy to get wrong, and it stacks with race-day adrenaline and nerves. Check with a doctor for what's right for you, and never test a new dose on race day itself - try it in training first."}
